rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MEOK Omnibus Tracker provides structured access to regulatory deadline tracking for the EU AI Act, GDPR, and DORA frameworks following the March 2026 Digital Omnibus legislative amendments. It exposes current compliance status for eight regulatory cliff dates, article-level change summaries, nearest deadline queries, and HMAC-signed status attestations. Distributed via PyPI.
